name: standmeet-everything-mcp
description: everything block as a dsh plugin: the MCP reference 'everything' server (a Node stdio-MCP demo server) bridged onto dsh through @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client. This subject package is a thin shell — it declares the server as a dependency (so dsh installs it into the profile) and carries the mcp-client patch; index.js is a stub only so dsh's package-entry resolution succeeds.
